venue: Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, San Francisco

location._comment: Filled in by scripts/create-venue.py. Empty id means the location does not exist yet.
location.name: Oct SF Hackathon

obstacles_fragment._comment: Table + ceiling only, no walls. Source: hackathon/fragments/hackathon-workcell-table-ceiling.json. Filled in by create-venue.py.
obstacles_fragment.name: hackathon-workcell-table-ceiling

_machine_prefix: Machines and hostnames are <prefix><station number>: sfhack1, sfhack2, ... One per compute box.

network._comment: Arm link is a static /24 on its own port, same as HQ. The venue LAN (switch) is DHCP on the other port with a low route metric so it is the default route. Wifi is a second default route with a higher metric and takes over only when the wire drops. Neither the LAN nor the wifi may hand out 192.168.1.x or arm traffic routes the wrong way.

workcell._comment: Box CENTERS, not faces. face = center +/- size/2. Table 200 thick -> top at z=-23. Ceiling 100 thick -> underside at z=1000. Same values as HQ; override per station with --table-z if a table differs.

camera._comment: Empty serial => the realsense module uses the first camera it finds (per module README). Every box has exactly one RealSense, so no serial detection is needed. verify-cell.py prints the serial the module actually picked if you want to pin it later.

arm_fragments._comment: Per-event arm fragments. 'current' is what clear-to-fragment.py puts a machine on; 'migrate_from' are older fragments that still identify the same arm model, so a not-yet-cleared machine is still recognised.
